p: with regard to … she may partake of teruma?
with regard to whether she may partake of teruma?
so that she not cast aspersions on her children.
And Rav Sheshet concedes that if
will say … now … that she was raped,
will say that only now it occurred that she was raped,
wife of a priest who was raped … she … receive
wife of a priest who was raped in the presence of witnesses, is she entitled to receive
she not entitled to receive payment of her marriage contract?
with regard to a … an Israelite, … she … not … receive … marriage contract?

with regard to a woman married to an Israelite, as the wife of a priest who was raped is obligated to leave her husband, just as the wife of an Israelite who willingly engaged in sexual intercourse with another man is obligated to leave her husband, she is therefore not entitled to receive payment of her marriage contract?
